subject: Preflight: proposed subprocessor addition — dataflow matrix & evidence request
messages:
From: Amit Desai <amit.desai@fintrade.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintrade.com, Legal - Fintrade <legal@fintrade.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Apr 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed subprocessor — preflight questions and required artifacts

Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday. As part of our procurement checklist we need to review any planned subprocessor additions that would touch customer data before we sign the DPA addendum. You mentioned a new telemetry aggregator your infra team intends to pilot (the proxy that will sit in front of observability).

Can you share the following for that proposed subprocessor?
- official name and legal entity
- role (telemetry/metrics/alerts/other) and minimal data elements it will see
- expected countries where processing will occur and any cross-border egress
- a short dataflow diagram and an exportability/egress map
- any SOC2/Security attestation, or evidence if not yet available (timeline)

If you can attach a matrix or packet that would let our security/legal team do a quick preflight that would be great. We are hoping to complete the pre-approval by next Friday if possible.

Best,
Amit Desai
Senior Security Analyst
Fintrade Solutions

--
Attachment: none

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Amit Desai <amit.desai@fintrade.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Legal - Fintrade <legal@fintrade.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed subprocessor — preflight questions and required artifacts

Amit — thanks for the clear list. Putting this on my plate now and looping in Marissa (privacy ops) and Jordan (procurement) to expedite. Ben is on infra and can confirm the deployment topology.

Quick summary so you know what to expect: the partner is "EdgeSight Analytics, Inc." (US entity), role: telemetry aggregation + short-term log buffering for observability (no persistent raw customer content storage). Processing will be primarily in us-west-2; we anticipate a limited EU fallback region for failover.

I attached a preliminary dataflow matrix and an egress-country map for your review. Note these are preflight artifacts — Ben will call out what we can lock down vs what is still under evaluation.

Requested next actions on our side:
- Ben to confirm encryption in transit and at rest for the aggregator and provide SOC2 timeline.
- Marissa to confirm whether this change requires a DPA addendum or can be covered by our existing subprocessor roster (short answer: likely an addendum).
- Kimberly to provide the matrix and target dates for evidence handoff.

Target: provide the full evidence packet by EOD Tue (6 Apr). If Fintrade needs an accelerated review we'll prioritize contract/attestation items.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: subprocessor_dataflow_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: egress_country_map.pdf (diagram)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 09:13:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed subprocessor — preflight questions and required artifacts

Kimberly / team — following up as promised. A few infra clarifications:
1) EdgeSight will be deployed in a managed SaaS mode inside our VPC by default; we will only forward de-identified telemetry and metrics. No customer prompt data or raw transcripts will be forwarded.
2) TLS 1.2+ for in-transit; AES-256 for rest. We'll require EdgeSight to present SOC2 Type II by Q3 2026 — short-term we can provide vendor self-attestation (see timeline below).
3) Egress: primary processing in us-west-2 (no egress outside the US for standard traffic). Failover triggers a routed session to eu-central-1 for customers in that region; egress map attached.

Timeline: evidence bundle (self-attestation, architecture note, contact for onboarding) — by EOD Tue (6 Apr). SOC2 report estimated by mid-August.

Ben
Principal Engineer, Infra Services
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: infra_note_edgesight.txt (plain text stub)

From: Amit Desai <amit.desai@fintrade.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintrade.com, Legal - Fintrade <legal@fintrade.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed subprocessor — preflight questions and required artifacts

Thanks Kim, Ben — this is helpful. A couple quick follow-ups from security/legal review after a brief look at the matrix:
- We need a confirmation that no PII or customer-generated content is forwarded in unredacted form. Your note says "de-identified telemetry" but we need specifics on what fields are stripped and the redaction method.
- For the EU fallback path, we need an assurance on standard contractual protections for data in transit and any subprocessors that EdgeSight uses in the EU. Can you provide the subcontractor roster for EdgeSight or confirm they will not chain further processors?
- Last: will onboarding require a DPA addendum or is a security questionnaire sufficient as an initial gating item?

If you can reply with the redaction field list and EdgeSight subcontractor confirmation by EOD Thursday (8 Apr) that will keep us on track. If SOC2 timing is as you noted we can accept a self-attestation for now but will need the Type II before production go-live.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this is one of the items holding our approval.

Regards,
Amit Desai
Senior Security Analyst
Fintrade Solutions

--
Attachments referenced: subprocessor_dataflow_matrix_v1.xlsx, egress_country_map.pdf
